verdict.rationale: Alloy documents ongoing screening of its own: scheduled Portfolio workflows, continuous portfolio monitoring, perpetual KYC/AML checks, and asynchronous watchlist-update events. Nothing in the evidence shows a compliance officer switching that screening on or off for specific customers. The only documented 'enable' control is mapping event types to Source Workflows, which works per event type, not per customer. Missing for 10: per-customer enrollment and unenrollment controls for ongoing screening, a dashboard or API toggle for selected customers, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
